subject: Scheduling: full-loop (paired interview stack) + debrief window for Sanaa Rahman
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanaa Rahman <sanaa.rahman@gmail.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Atlas Talent <talent@atlascorp.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + proposed windows for Redwood Fullloop (Engineering Manager position)

Hi Sanaa — great to meet you over email and thanks again for your time yesterday on the phone. Vivek (hiring manager) and I chatted and we have a couple of options for the virtual full-loop. We want to keep the day focused and compact while giving you a good cross-section of the team.

Candidate timezone: EDT (you mentioned mornings work best) — below times are shown in EDT and converted to PT for the panel.

Option A (compact stack, single contiguous block)
- 09:00–10:20 EDT (6x20 minute segments + 20m buffer/debrief) — system design (pair), coding deep-dive, culture/PM, bar-raiser.

Option B (split with morning buffer)
- 09:00–09:50 EDT: Pair programming (Karthik + Jonas)
- 10:10–11:00 EDT: System design + manager deep-dive (Vivek + Laura)
- 11:10–11:30 EDT: Culture / org fit (one-on-one)

Can you confirm which option you prefer and whether Tues/Wed next week (29–30 Jul) mornings work? If both work we'll lock one and share the final agenda + calendar invite.

Attachments: resume (attached). I also included a draft agenda (fullloop_paired-agenda_v2.pdf) for internal reference.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole | Talent Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Sanaa Rahman <sanaa.rahman@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Atlas Talent <talent@atlascorp.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 17:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed windows for Redwood Fullloop (Engineering Manager position)

Hi Marissa and Vivek — thanks for the options and for coordinating. 

Option A (single contiguous block) works best for me — I prefer not to break the flow. Either day is fine but Wed 30 Jul morning EDT would be ideal. I can do 09:00–10:30 EDT. 

Please let me know the confirmed time and any prep I should do for the pair session (languages, editor preference, shared whiteboard).

Best,
Sanaa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 17:28:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Candidate confirmed — Wednesday 30 Jul 09:00–10:30 EDT (Sanaa Rahman) — agenda ask

Folks — Sanaa confirmed Option A for Wed 30 Jul, 09:00–10:30 EDT (09:00–10:30 EDT == 06:00–07:30 PT). She prefers the contiguous block. Draft agenda attached (paired + stacked flow). Can you review the sequencing and callout who will lead each segment? High-level ask: keep pair programming first so momentum is high, leave a 15–20m wrap/debrief window at the end for rapid consensus.

Draft agenda (attached):
- 09:00–09:35 EDT: Pair programming (Karthik + Jonas) — shared code exercise, 20m active + 15m review
- 09:35–10:05 EDT: System design / architecture deep-dive (Vivek)
- 10:05–10:20 EDT: Manager + culture / org fit (Laura)
- 10:20–10:30 EDT: Panel debrief & immediate feedback (all)

Questions / constraints:
- Jonas: can you host the pair session in Replit + share link? If you prefer CoderPad, note in reply.
- Karthik: are you able to be the pair-driving interviewer for the coding slot? We generally do the coding first for candidate comfort.
- Vivek: please confirm if you'd like a short 1:1 with Sanaa after the system design (we currently consolidate manager Qs during the culture slot).

Attachments: fullloop_paired-agenda_v2.pdf, Sanaa_Rahman_Resume.pdf

Marissa
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 19:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate confirmed — Wednesday 30 Jul 09:00–10:30 EDT (Sanaa Rahman) — agenda ask

Thanks Marissa — looks good. A few small tweaks from my side to balance depth + time:

1) Pair first: agreed. Karthik and Jonas will run the pair session, but let's structure it as 25m active (candidate drives, we seed clarifying prompts) + 10m focused review — this buys a bit more runway for the design slot.
2) System design: make it 25m, but narrow prompt to a single-scenario (data ingestion pipeline + scaling) so we can get to tradeoffs quickly. I'll host the design and will share a short prompt in the shared Drive link before the interview.
3) Manager touch: Laura, please keep manager/org fit to 10m with 3 prioritized topics (career goals, collaboration style, remote experience).
4) Debrief: extend to 15m to allow quick scoring and a single follow-up action (offer screen/pass/next stage).

Jonas — please confirm Replit vs CoderPad. If you're short on time, ping me and I'll swap in a backup interviewer (I can cover the system design and step out of the manager slot).

Marissa — once we lock final times I'll send the calendar invite and attach the agenda + evaluation rubric. Also please include the shared Drive link for the prompt and the candidate resume.

Vivek
Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanaa Rahman <sanaa.rahman@gmail.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Wed 30 Jul 09:00–10:30 EDT — Final agenda + calendar invite

Hi Sanaa — confirmed for Wednesday, 30 Jul at 09:00–10:30 EDT. Calendar invite attached (calendar_invite_SRahman.ics). Final agenda below and a short note on logistics.

Final agenda (all times EDT)
- 09:00–09:25: Pair programming (Karthik Iyer + Jonas Weber) — 25m exercise then 10m review within the same slot
- 09:25–09:50: System design (Vivek Kulkarni) — focused scenario: data ingestion & scaling (prompt in Drive)
- 09:50–10:00: Manager / org fit (Laura Bennett) — targeted questions
- 10:00–10:15: Panel debrief (Karthik, Jonas, Vivek, Laura) — quick scoring and next-step consensus

Logistics:
- Pair session: Jonas will host in Replit; link will be posted in the calendar event 10 minutes before start. Please be prepared to share your screen and use a simple editor. No IDE install required.
- Prep: read the short system prompt in the shared Drive link (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcFullloopAgenda) — we keep it high-level; no lengthy prework required.
- Attachments: your resume (Sanaa_Rahman_Resume.pdf), final agenda (fullloop_paired-agenda_v2.pdf) are attached.

If anything changes or you need to move the time, reply and we'll re-align. Looking forward to meeting you.

Best,
Marissa Cole | Talent Operations | Redwood Inference
